name: agentic-emulator

tools.name: devices
tools.description: List Android and iOS devices with state, profile and screen size.

tools.name: profiles
tools.description: List screen profiles (real device sizes) usable with set_profile.

tools.name: create
tools.description: Create a new device.

tools.name: boot
tools.description: Boot a device to an agent-ready state; from its baseline snapshot this takes seconds and returns state booted. The first boot of a new Android device (or a baseline retake after a GPU mode, AVD configuration or agemu upgrade) prepares the baseline once, which usually takes 7-8 minutes and never more than 20 (then the boot fails): boot then returns at once with state "preparing" and the phase; poll devices every 30-60 s (or call boot again) until the state is booted. Other calls on a preparing device fail at once with an error saying so.

device.description: Device id or name (optional when exactly one device is booted)

tools.name: shutdown
tools.description: Shut a device down.

device.description: Device id or name (optional when exactly one device is booted)

tools.name: reset
tools.description: Restore a booted device to its clean baseline state (fast).

device.description: Device id or name (optional when exactly one device is booted)

tools.name: park
tools.description: Park a booted device: stop it in place, so it uses no CPU and the host can reclaim its memory, keeping its apps and screen as they are. The next call on it resumes it (or use resume).

device.description: Device id or name (optional when exactly one device is booted)

tools.name: resume
tools.description: Resume a parked device; returns once it is agent-ready. Does nothing on a device that is not parked.

device.description: Device id or name (optional when exactly one device is booted)

tools.name: set_profile
tools.description: Switch the screen to a real-device profile (see profiles) or a custom Android size.

device.description: Device id or name (optional when exactly one device is booted)

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Capture the screen. Returns the image plus its file path. Coordinates on a scale=1 image are tap coordinates.

device.description: Device id or name (optional when exactly one device is booted)

scale.description: Downscale factor 0-1 for the returned image (default 0.5)

tools.name: ui_tree
tools.description: Accessibility/UI hierarchy as a compact outline: [ref] role "text" id=... @(x,y wxh). Frames are screenshot pixels.

device.description: Device id or name (optional when exactly one device is booted)

json.description: Return full JSON instead of the outline

tools.name: find
tools.description: Find elements by text/label/id/role.

contains.description: Case-insensitive substring of text or label

device.description: Device id or name (optional when exactly one device is booted)

role.description: Normalized role: button, text, textfield, switch, image, cell...

tools.name: tap
tools.description: Tap at x,y (screenshot pixels) or at the center of the element matching a selector. With waitFor it also waits for the next screen.

contains.description: Case-insensitive substring of text or label

device.description: Device id or name (optional when exactly one device is booted)

returnUi.description: Also return the UI outline of the screen the action ends on (act, wait and observe in one call)

role.description: Normalized role: button, text, textfield, switch, image, cell...

waitFor.description: After the action, wait for an element matching this selector (fields: text, contains, id, role) in the same call

waitGone.description: Wait for waitFor to disappear instead

tools.name: swipe
tools.description: Swipe from (x,y) to (x2,y2) in screenshot pixels.

device.description: Device id or name (optional when exactly one device is booted)

returnUi.description: Also return the UI outline of the screen the action ends on (act, wait and observe in one call)

waitFor.description: After the action, wait for an element matching this selector (fields: text, contains, id, role) in the same call

waitGone.description: Wait for waitFor to disappear instead

tools.name: type_text
tools.description: Type text into the focused field.

device.description: Device id or name (optional when exactly one device is booted)

keys.description: Send one key event per character (slower) instead of setting the field's text (Android) or pasting it (iOS)

returnUi.description: Also return the UI outline of the screen the action ends on (act, wait and observe in one call)

waitFor.description: After the action, wait for an element matching this selector (fields: text, contains, id, role) in the same call

waitGone.description: Wait for waitFor to disappear instead

tools.name: press_key
tools.description: Press a key: home, back, enter, delete, tab, escape, lock, volumeup, volumedown.

device.description: Device id or name (optional when exactly one device is booted)

returnUi.description: Also return the UI outline of the screen the action ends on (act, wait and observe in one call)

waitFor.description: After the action, wait for an element matching this selector (fields: text, contains, id, role) in the same call

waitGone.description: Wait for waitFor to disappear instead

tools.name: install
tools.description: Install an app (.apk for Android, .app for iOS Simulator).

device.description: Device id or name (optional when exactly one device is booted)

tools.name: launch
tools.description: Launch an app by package name / bundle id. iOS also takes process arguments (e.g. an Expo dev client's --initialUrl), environment and relaunch.

device.description: Device id or name (optional when exactly one device is booted)

returnUi.description: Also return the UI outline of the screen the action ends on (act, wait and observe in one call)

waitFor.description: After the action, wait for an element matching this selector (fields: text, contains, id, role) in the same call

waitGone.description: Wait for waitFor to disappear instead

tools.name: terminate
tools.description: Force-stop an app.

device.description: Device id or name (optional when exactly one device is booted)

tools.name: wait_for
tools.description: Wait until an element matching the selector appears (or disappears with gone=true).

contains.description: Case-insensitive substring of text or label

device.description: Device id or name (optional when exactly one device is booted)

role.description: Normalized role: button, text, textfield, switch, image, cell...

tools.name: open_url
tools.description: Open a URL or deep link as a link tapped in another app would (Android: VIEW intent with CATEGORY_BROWSABLE). App/universal links open the app only if their domain is verified. With waitFor it also waits for the next screen.

device.description: Device id or name (optional when exactly one device is booted)

returnUi.description: Also return the UI outline of the screen the action ends on (act, wait and observe in one call)

url.description: URL with a scheme: https://..., myapp://path, exp+app://...

waitFor.description: After the action, wait for an element matching this selector (fields: text, contains, id, role) in the same call

waitGone.description: Wait for waitFor to disappear instead

tools.name: permission
tools.description: Grant, revoke or reset an app's privacy permissions without the system dialog. revoke = denied without asking again; reset = ask again on next use. Android kills the app when one is revoked or reset. A grant the app could not get on a device (not in its manifest / no Info.plist usage description) is refused.

device.description: Device id or name (optional when exactly one device is booted)

permissions.description: Names: camera, microphone, photos, photos-add, location, location-always, contacts, contacts-limited, calendar, reminders, notifications, motion, media-library, siri; or a raw Android permission (android.permission.READ_SMS). Not every name exists on both platforms. Empty with reset: all of the app's permissions.

tools.name: location
tools.description: Set the simulated GPS location, or clear it (back to the device's baseline).

action.description: set (default when coordinates are given) or clear

device.description: Device id or name (optional when exactly one device is booted)

tools.name: clipboard
tools.description: Read the device clipboard (plain text), or set it.

action.description: get (default) or set (default when text is given)

device.description: Device id or name (optional when exactly one device is booted)

text.description: Text to put on the clipboard (action set; empty clears it)

tools.name: appearance
tools.description: Read the system appearance, or switch light/dark mode.

device.description: Device id or name (optional when exactly one device is booted)

mode.description: Omit to read the current appearance

tools.name: apps
tools.description: List installed user apps (not the system image's).

device.description: Device id or name (optional when exactly one device is booted)

tools.name: uninstall
tools.description: Uninstall a user app with its data.

device.description: Device id or name (optional when exactly one device is booted)

tools.name: clear_app_data
tools.description: Clear one app's data so it starts like a fresh install (stopped, data and permissions gone; iOS keeps keychain items, as a reinstall does on a device).

device.description: Device id or name (optional when exactly one device is booted)

tools.name: push
tools.description: Send a push notification to an app (iOS; Android has no faithful path). It shows only if the app may post notifications. With waitFor it also waits for the banner or screen.

device.description: Device id or name (optional when exactly one device is booted)

payload.description: APNs payload with an "aps" object, at most 4096 bytes, e.g. {"aps":{"alert":{"title":"Hi","body":"Hello"}}}

returnUi.description: Also return the UI outline of the screen the action ends on (act, wait and observe in one call)

waitFor.description: After the action, wait for an element matching this selector (fields: text, contains, id, role) in the same call

waitGone.description: Wait for waitFor to disappear instead

tools.name: logs
tools.description: Recent log lines of one app (or the whole device), oldest first, as `time level process[pid] tag: message`. Filter by time, minimum level and text; the newest lines that fit limit and maxBytes are returned. The last line gives a cursor: pass it as since to read only newer lines.

app.description: Package name or bundle id: only its processes' lines (default: every process)

contains.description: Case-insensitive substring of the tag or the message

device.description: Device id or name (optional when exactly one device is booted)

json.description: Return JSON instead of text lines

level.description: Minimum level (iOS: debug lines are not captured; info includes iOS default)

limit.description: At most this many lines, the newest (default 100, max 10000)

maxBytes.description: At most about this many bytes of lines (default 16384, max 1048576)

regex.description: RE2 regular expression matched against the tag or the message

since.description: Only lines from this point: a time (2026-11-07T10:00:00Z), a duration back from now (30s, 5m), "launch" (the app's last launch through agemu) or a cursor from a previous logs result (c123...)

tools.name: crashes
tools.description: Crash, ANR (Android), system-kill (iOS watchdog, jetsam) and unexpected-exit reports of the device's apps, oldest first: time, kind, exception, reason and the crashing thread's top frames.

app.description: Package name or bundle id (default: every app)

device.description: Device id or name (optional when exactly one device is booted)

limit.description: At most this many reports, the newest (default 10, max 100)

since.description: A time (2026-11-07T10:00:00Z), a duration back from now (5m) or "launch" (the app's last launch through agemu)

instructions: Drive Android emulators and iOS Simulators. Typical loop: devices -> boot -> launch -> ui_tree -> tap/type_text -> wait_for -> screenshot. Coordinates are screenshot pixels. Test setup: permission, location, appearance, clipboard, open_url, push, clear_app_data; reset restores appearance, location, clipboard and permissions. Debugging: logs, crashes; when the app you launched crashes, the next result starts with a NOTE line and errors say so. A new Android device's first boot returns state preparing (usually 7-8 min, at most 20, once): poll devices until booted; if devices shows noBaseline, call boot again.
